openSeaMetadata.description:

not try to buy/bid on Sneakers with Equipped Skins in this collection.

Only buy / bid on Skin VIALS in this collection : 
https://opensea.io/collection/skinvial-evox

Get your EVO X RTFKT SKIN VIALS: https://opensea.io/collection/skinvial-evox
EQUIP your Skins : https://mnlth.rtfkt.com/

nfts.name: RTFKT x Nike Dunk Genesis CRYPTOKICKS

https://opensea.io/collection/skinvial-evox

Get your EVO X RTFKT SKIN VIALS: https://opensea.io/collection/skinvial-evox
EQUIP your Skins : https://mnlth.rtfkt.com/

nfts.name: RTFKT x Nike Dunk Genesis CRYPTOKICKS

nfts.name: SUPERGUCCI BLOSSOM - #1
nfts.description: A groundbreaking collaboration between Gucci and Superplastic, SUPERGUCCI is a two-part series of ultra-limited NFTs co-created by Gucci’s Creative Director Alessandro Michele and synthetic artists Janky & Guggimon. The first drop, featuring Janky, incorporates House codes found in the Gucci Aria collection. The second drop, spotlighting Guggimon embellished with the Gucci Love Parade aesthetics, was airdropped to the holders of the first NFT as a token of gratitude. Both drops are accompanied by an exclusive 8-inch tall ceramic SUPERGUCCI sculpture, hand-crafted by ceramicists in Italy. Only 500 NFTs were minted for each drop.

The first drop, featuring Janky, incorporates House codes found in the Gucci Aria collection. The second drop, spotlighting Guggimon embellished with the Gucci Love Parade aesthetics, was airdropped to the holders of the first NFT as a token of gratitude. Both drops are accompanied by an exclusive 8-inch tall ceramic SUPERGUCCI sculpture, hand-crafted by ceramicists in Italy. Only 500 NFTs were minted for each drop.

The NFT includes the drop serial number and the numbering of each physical item in order to have an exact correspondence. NFT owners are then offered exclusive benefits and experiences as well as access to future drops.

In a play on shapes, the iconic capsule, the symbol of Prada Timecapsule #30 drops, is transformed into the emblem of artist Cassius Hirst, his cerebral scan.



Terms and conditions: [www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal](https://www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal)

openSeaMetadata.description:
Launched for the first time on December 5, 2019, Prada Timecapsule is a monthly online event. For 24 hours, each first Thursday, an exclusive item which forms part of this collection is made available on [prada.com](https://www.prada.com) in very limited quantities in selected markets. Now Prada Timecapsule is renewed by entering a new phase and expanding its creative presence in the Web3 with the Timecapsule NFT Collection: each limited edition physical product will be accompanied by a gifted NFT. 

Terms and Conditions: [www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal](https://www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal)

The NFT includes the drop serial number and the numbering of each physical item in order to have an exact correspondence. NFT owners are then offered exclusive benefits and experiences as well as access to future drops.

In a play on shapes, the iconic capsule, the symbol of Prada Timecapsule #30 drops, is transformed into the emblem of artist Cassius Hirst, his cerebral scan.



Terms and conditions: [www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal](https://www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal)

For 24 hours, each first Thursday, an exclusive item which forms part of this collection is made available on [prada.com](https://www.prada.com) in very limited quantities in selected markets. Now Prada Timecapsule is renewed by entering a new phase and expanding its creative presence in the Web3 with the Timecapsule NFT Collection: each limited edition physical product will be accompanied by a gifted NFT. 

Terms and Conditions: [www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal](https://www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal)

nfts.name: PRADA Timecapsule: June 2022 - Cass x Prada
nfts.description:
The Prada Timecapsule NFT is gifted alongside the physical Timecapsule piece.

The NFT includes the drop serial number and the numbering of each physical item in order to have an exact correspondence. NFT owners are then offered exclusive benefits and experiences as well as access to future drops.

In a play on shapes, the iconic capsule, the symbol of Prada Timecapsule #30 drops, is transformed into the emblem of artist Cassius Hirst, his cerebral scan.



Terms and conditions: [www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal](https://www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal)

The Prada Timecapsule NFT is gifted alongside the physical Timecapsule piece.

The NFT includes the drop serial number and the numbering of each physical item in order to have an exact correspondence. NFT owners are then offered exclusive benefits and experiences as well as access to future drops.

In a play on shapes, the iconic capsule, the symbol of Prada Timecapsule #30 drops, is transformed into the emblem of artist Cassius Hirst, his cerebral scan.



Terms and conditions: [www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal](https://www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal)

openSeaMetadata.description:
Launched for the first time on December 5, 2019, Prada Timecapsule is a monthly online event. For 24 hours, each first Thursday, an exclusive item which forms part of this collection is made available on [prada.com](https://www.prada.com) in very limited quantities in selected markets. Now Prada Timecapsule is renewed by entering a new phase and expanding its creative presence in the Web3 with the Timecapsule NFT Collection: each limited edition physical product will be accompanied by a gifted NFT. 

Terms and Conditions: [www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal](https://www.prada.com/prada-crypted/legal)

openSeaMetadata.description:
Created as an exclusive partnership between Dolce&Gabbana and UNXD, Collezione Genesi was first revealed in Summer 2021 at the Dolce&Gabbana Alta Moda couture event in the world’s most unique city: Venice.

This 9-piece, one-of-a-kind collection was personally designed by Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana exclusively for UNXD. It features entirely hand-made, museum-grade items across Alta Moda (women), Alta Sartoria (men), and Alta Gioielleria (high jewelry).

In a historic moment for the NFT ecosystem, Collezione Genesi was the first luxury NFT collection that involves both digital and physical works, truly bridging the physical and the metaphysical. See the announcement on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/dolcegabbana/status/1434912403175641089)

nfts.name: The Velvet Impossible Jacket
nfts.description:
Personally designed by Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana, The Mosaic Impossible Jacket stems from the idea that the only limitation in digital design is one’s imagination. This was hugely inspiring to the designers, who set out to create a jacket that only exists in their imagination. Inspired by one of Venice’s most spectacular sites, The Mosaic Impossible Jacket is a stunning piece of digital wearable art.

[View on UNXD](https://unxd.com/drops/collezione-genesi/the-velvet-impossible-jacket)

nfts.name: The Doge Crown
nfts.description:
Personally designed by Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana, The Doge Crown is inspired by Venice’s most famous location: Piazza San Marco. Within Piazza San Marco resides the Doge’s Palace (also known as Palazzo Ducale) along with the famous clock tower. On the top of the clock tower there is the symbol of Venice, the sun with a face, which is also represented inside the clock tower. This museum-grade piece of sculptural art took hundreds of hours to create by hand across both the physical and digital versions. Legend has it that the special collector that owns The Doge Crown will thereafter be the anointed King of Crypto...

[View on UNXD](https://unxd.com/drops/collezione-genesi/the-doge-crown)

nfts.name: The Doge Crown
nfts.description:
Personally designed by Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana, The Doge Crown is inspired by Venice’s most famous location: Piazza San Marco. Within Piazza San Marco resides the Doge’s Palace (also known as Palazzo Ducale) along with the famous clock tower. On the top of the clock tower there is the symbol of Venice, the sun with a face, which is also represented inside the clock tower. This museum-grade piece of sculptural art took hundreds of hours to create by hand across both the physical and digital versions. Legend has it that the special collector that owns The Doge Crown will thereafter be the anointed King of Crypto...

[View on UNXD](https://unxd.com/drops/collezione-genesi/the-doge-crown)

openSeaMetadata.description:
EXCLUSIVE ACCESS TO THE DOLCE&GABBANA NFT UNIVERSE. DGFamily Boxes are digital collectibles (NFTs) that also serve as tiered membership to the exclusive Dolce&Gabbana universe. 

DGFamily members receive exclusive digital, physical, and experiential privileges as Dolce&Gabbana pushes the boundaries of luxury and culture in the metaverse. 

DGFamily boxes are based on the classic Italian Carretto style, and crafted in three increasingly rarer tiers. DGFamily is an exclusive partnership between Dolce&Gabbana and UNXD.

openSeaMetadata.collectionName: RTFKT x RIMOWA Meta Artisan Collection
openSeaMetadata.description: [rimowa.rtfkt.com](https://rtfktrimowa.com) - The RTFKT x RIMOWA Meta-Artisan Collection 🌌Encompassing a new collection of NFTs, limited-edition luggage and a robot collectible, the new collaboration brings to life —and to the Metaverse— the ultimate experience for RIMOWA enthusiasts and Web3 collectors. Combining their respective craftsmanship, RTFKT and RIMOWA have come together to create a RTFKT x RIMOWA limited edition Original Cabin Luggage, with only 888 pieces produced – a nod to the luck associated with the number in the web3 world.Alongside the digital and physical iterations of the Cabin Luggage, there are 2222 NFTs of a robot collectible. Designed by RTFKT, the NFT takes the form of a space WorkerBot, The Wandersmith’s trusted assistant, within the RTFKT x RIMOWA universe.

nfts.name: RTFKT x RIMOWA “Meta-Artisan” Original Cabin Luggage 🚀
nfts.description:
The unmistakable RIMOWA Original Cabin Silver with its distinctive grooves is regarded as one of the most iconic luggage designs of all time.

Features the RTFKT Special Limited Edition “Wandersmith” Anti-FUD pattern print, made for next-gen world builders and explorers.

See the full collection here: https://rimowa.rtfkt.com  👀

Cabin Luggage NFT owners will be able to redeem (forge) a limited edition RTFKT x RIMOWA Original Cabin Luggage during the Forging event. Forged physical cabin luggage will be equipped with an NFC tag 🔗. You will be able to link your NFT with the NFC tag on your forged physical cabin luggage item. NFT owners will be able to download licensed wearable 3D models of the cabin luggage content at a later date.

Digital Collectible terms and conditions apply, see https://rtfkt.com/legal-2D

Digital Collectible and Forging-Eligible (this 1155 Token will be swapped for a 721 Token when forging)

Third Party Rights Owner Notice: RIMOWA GmbH

Forging terms apply, see: https://rtfkt.com/legal-1B 👨‍⚖️

nfts.name: RTFKT x RIMOWA WorkerBot 🤖
nfts.description:

contract.name: Asprey Bugatti La Voiture Noire Collection

openSeaMetadata.collectionName: Asprey Bugatti La Voiture Noire Collection
openSeaMetadata.description:
The first Asprey Bugatti Collection: La Voiture Noire. 
Heritage. Artistry. Vision. - Objets d’Art for the future.

Introducing the 261 Collection: a series of 261 unique sculptural artworks, inspired by the legendary BUGATTI La Voiture Noire and seamlessly interwoven with NFT technology. This inaugural masterpiece marks the genesis collaboration between Asprey and BUGATTI.

A fusion of centuries of artistry and engineering excellence, this collection bridges the physical and digital worlds. The handcrafted sterling silver sculptures, now unattainable with the claim period closed, live on through their NFT counterparts, preserving their exclusivity for a new era of collectors.

Asprey and BUGATTI continue to redefine art, luxury, and craftsmanship, creating a new dimension where automotive excellence meets objet d’art.

For more details, visit aspreystudio.com

nfts.name: First Edition 001/261
nfts.description: The first-ever Asprey Bugatti Collection: La Voiture Noire. A limited series of 261 collectible NFT artworks. This collection originally included a redeemable sterling silver sculpture, handcrafted in Asprey Studio’s London workshop, and paired with exclusive digital artwork. Collectors now hold a rare digital representation of this legacy collaboration. For more details, visit aspreystudio.com.

openSeaMetadata.collectionName: Asprey Bugatti La Voiture Noire Collection
openSeaMetadata.description:
The first Asprey Bugatti Collection: La Voiture Noire. 
Heritage. Artistry. Vision. - Objets d’Art for the future.

Introducing the 261 Collection: a series of 261 unique sculptural artworks, inspired by the legendary BUGATTI La Voiture Noire and seamlessly interwoven with NFT technology. This inaugural masterpiece marks the genesis collaboration between Asprey and BUGATTI.

A fusion of centuries of artistry and engineering excellence, this collection bridges the physical and digital worlds. The handcrafted sterling silver sculptures, now unattainable with the claim period closed, live on through their NFT counterparts, preserving their exclusivity for a new era of collectors.

Asprey and BUGATTI continue to redefine art, luxury, and craftsmanship, creating a new dimension where automotive excellence meets objet d’art.

For more details, visit aspreystudio.com

nfts.name: First Edition 075/261
nfts.description: The first-ever Asprey Bugatti Collection: La Voiture Noire. A limited series of 261 collectible NFT artworks. This collection originally included a redeemable sterling silver sculpture, handcrafted in Asprey Studio’s London workshop, and paired with exclusive digital artwork. Collectors now hold a rare digital representation of this legacy collaboration. For more details, visit aspreystudio.com.

Heritage. Artistry. Vision. - Objets d’Art for the future.

Introducing the 261 Collection: a series of 261 unique sculptural artworks, inspired by the legendary BUGATTI La Voiture Noire and seamlessly interwoven with NFT technology. This inaugural masterpiece marks the genesis collaboration between Asprey and BUGATTI.

A fusion of centuries of artistry and engineering excellence, this collection bridges the physical and digital worlds. The handcrafted sterling silver sculptures, now unattainable with the claim period closed, live on through their NFT counterparts, preserving their exclusivity for a new era of collectors.

Asprey and BUGATTI continue to redefine art, luxury, and craftsmanship, creating a new dimension where automotive excellence meets objet d’art.

For more details, visit aspreystudio.com

openSeaMetadata.description: Mercedes-Benz NXT aims to take Mercedes-Benz’s top customers along on its journey. That’s why this core collection, called “Mercedes-Benz NXT Eternities,” will be exclusively bestowed upon a small number of selected Mercedes-Benz top customers and minted IRL over time at top-customer events.

nfts.name: Mercedes-Benz NXT Eternities #1
nfts.description:
“Mercedes-Benz NXT Eternities” were designed by the Mercedes-Benz Design team, led by Gorden Wagener. They feature the iconic brand logos of Mercedes-Benz, Mercedes-AMG, and Mercedes-Maybach.
